pronunciation: gahng-dee-en (rising tone on 'gahng', falling tone on 'dee-en')
meaning: to farm; to till/cultivate the fields
note: Hakka communities in Taiwan historically settled hilly, less fertile land, so 耕田 carries a strong cultural association with the hardworking Hakka farming identity, often linked to the spirit of 硬頸 (stubborn/tenacious).
